documents.title: The Factories Act, 1948
documents.extracted_text: An Act to consolidate and amend the law regulating labour in factories. Contains provisions regarding health, safety, welfare, working hours of adults, employment of young persons, and annual leave with wages in manufacturing facilities.
documents.extracted_summary: Comprehensive legislation governing health, safety, working conditions, overtime regulations, and welfare amenities for industrial workers across Indian manufacturing premises.

key_sections.title: General duties of the occupier
key_sections.obligation: Ensure health, safety, and welfare of all workers in factory

key_sections.title: Cleanliness
key_sections.obligation: Maintain cleanliness and disposal of industrial wastes

key_sections.title: Fencing of machinery
key_sections.obligation: Secure fencing of dangerous transmission machinery

documents.title: The Environment (Protection) Act, 1986
documents.issuing_authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (CPCB)
documents.extracted_text: An Act to provide for the protection and improvement of environment and for matters connected therewith. Formulates environmental quality standards, emission thresholds, hazardous substance handling restrictions, and environmental clearance mandates.
documents.extracted_summary: Umbrella environmental protection legislation setting emissions limits, effluent discharge guidelines, mandatory Environmental Clearances (EC), and hazardous waste oversight.

key_sections.title: Persons carrying on industry not to allow emission in excess of standards
key_sections.obligation: Discharge emissions strictly within CPCB permissible limits

key_sections.title: Furnishing of information to authorities
key_sections.obligation: Immediate notification in event of environmental accidents

documents.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP)
documents.issuing_authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
documents.extracted_text: An Act to provide for the processing of digital personal data in a manner that recognises both the right of individuals to protect their personal data and the need to process such personal data for lawful purposes.
documents.extracted_summary: National data privacy governance act mandating consent architectures, data fiduciary duties, security safeguards, breach reporting to the Data Protection Board, and cross-border transfer parameters.

key_sections.title: Consent and Notice Requirements
key_sections.obligation: Obtain unambiguous, freely given, specific consent with clear purpose notice

key_sections.title: General obligations of Data Fiduciary
key_sections.obligation: Implement reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach

documents.title: Companies (Corporate Social Responsibility Policy) Amendment Rules, 2021
documents.extracted_text: Rules governing CSR expenditure, impact assessment requirements for projects over 1 Crore, registration of implementing agencies (Form CSR-1), and unspent CSR account treatment.
documents.extracted_summary: Corporate governance statutory rules detailing mandatory CSR expenditure schedules, impact assessment guidelines, board disclosures, and unspent CSR transfers.

key_sections.title: CSR Implementation
key_sections.obligation: Mandatory Form CSR-1 registration with MCA for implementing agencies

key_sections.title: CSR Reporting
key_sections.obligation: Annual board report on CSR activities with detailed Annexure disclosures

documents.title: SEBI Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting (BRSR Core) Framework
documents.issuing_authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
documents.extracted_text: Framework mandating ESG disclosures and reasonable assurance for the top 1000 listed entities by market capitalization. Enforces KPI metrics across GHG emissions, water consumption, circular economy, employee gender diversity, and supply chain ESG due diligence.
documents.extracted_summary: SEBI's statutory ESG disclosure regulation introducing the BRSR Core metrics and mandatory third-party reasonable assurance for listed corporations.

key_sections.title: Annual Report BRSR Disclosures
key_sections.obligation: Top 1000 listed companies must file annual BRSR report alongside financial results

key_sections.title: Value Chain Due Diligence
key_sections.obligation: Disclose Scope 3 emissions and supplier ESG compliance assessments

documents.title: RBI Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices
documents.extracted_text: Regulatory directions for regulated entities regarding IT governance structure, cybersecurity risk management, digital payment security, vendor third-party risk assessment, operational resilience, and mandatory 6-hour cyber incident notification.
documents.extracted_summary: Mandatory RBI framework establishing enterprise IT architecture governance, board oversight, continuous VAPT audits, and business continuity protocols for financial institutions.

key_sections.title: IT Risk & Cyber Security Management
key_sections.obligation: Establish dedicated IT Strategy Committee of the Board and conduct annual cyber audits

key_sections.title: Third-Party Vendor Risk
key_sections.obligation: Implement continuous security monitoring for outsourced technology service providers

documents.title: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Amendment Regulations
documents.issuing_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
documents.extracted_text: Comprehensive guidelines governing mandatory food business operator (FBO) registration, state and central licensing criteria, hygiene audit ratings, traceability compliance, and food laboratory test certifications.
documents.extracted_summary: Statutory food licensing regulations specifying threshold requirements, sanitary operating protocols, annual return submittals, and FoSCoS portal compliance procedures.

key_sections.title: Licensing Thresholds
key_sections.obligation: FBOs with turnover above ₹12 Lakhs must secure mandatory state or central FSSAI license

key_sections.title: Food Recall & Traceability
key_sections.obligation: Maintain verifiable forward and backward ingredient tracking registers

documents.title: Maharashtra Shops and Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act
documents.extracted_text: An Act to regulate the conditions of work and employment in shops, commercial establishments, IT/ITeS parks, and residential hotels in Maharashtra. Covers working hours, spread-over, mandatory overtime wages at double rates, and women shift safety.
documents.extracted_summary: State legislation replacing the Bombay Shops Act, introducing Aadhaar-linked online intimation for units under 10 workers and 24/7 operating exemptions with transport safeguards.

key_sections.title: Intimation of commencement of business
key_sections.obligation: Submit online Form F intimation within 60 days of business launch

key_sections.title: Working hours and overtime
key_sections.obligation: Maximum 9 hours/day, 48 hours/week with statutory overtime compensation at double rate

documents.title: Foreign Trade Policy (FTP 2023) Export Authorization & SCOMET Compliance Guidelines
documents.extracted_text: Strategic guidelines under FTP 2023 regulating SCOMET (Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies) dual-use export authorizations, internal compliance programmes (ICP), and paperless customs clearance.
documents.extracted_summary: Official DGFT trade regulatory circular introducing electronic authorization procedures, advance export licenses, and end-user verification protocols for exporters.

key_sections.title: SCOMET Authorization Protocol
key_sections.obligation: Mandatory licensing and end-user certificate filing for dual-use tech export shipments

key_sections.title: Internal Compliance Programme (ICP)
key_sections.obligation: Establish internal audit and compliance teams to monitor export control adherence
